extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome UI.

extDesc.message: Full page, region & visible screenshots with an annotation editor. Export PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF. 100% private, offline, no uploads.
extDesc.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and extensions page.

modeFullPage.description: Capture mode: capture the entire scrolling page.

modeFullPageSub.description: Subtitle for the Full Page capture mode.

modeVisible.description: Capture mode: capture what is currently visible.

modeVisibleSub.description: Subtitle for the Visible Area capture mode.

modeRegion.description: Capture mode: capture a user-dragged region.

modeRegionSub.description: Subtitle for the Selected Region capture mode.

capturing.description: Status shown while a capture is in progress.

cannotCaptureProtected.description: Error shown when the active page cannot be captured (e.g. chrome:// pages).

comingSoon.description: Placeholder message for features not yet implemented.

customizeShortcuts.description: Link that opens Chrome's extension shortcut settings.

reopenLast.description: Link in the popup that reopens the most recent capture in the editor.

recRecordings.description: Link in the popup that opens the recorder page's session list.

footerShortcuts.description: Short footer label for the link that opens Chrome's shortcut settings.

footerKofi.description: Short footer label for the Ko-fi donation link.

supportKofiTitle.message: Buy the developer a coffee on Ko-fi
supportKofiTitle.description: Tooltip for the Ko-fi donation footer link.

footerCoolStuff.description: Accessible label for the gift icon footer link that opens the cool-stuff page.

coolStuffTitle.message: Cool stuff — more free tools by the same maker
coolStuffTitle.description: Tooltip for the gift icon footer link.

setupCoolStuff.description: Trust strip link on the setup page that opens the cool-stuff page.

filenameInsert.description: Label above the clickable filename token chips.

couldNotReach.message: Could not reach the background worker.
couldNotReach.description: Error toast when the background service worker is unreachable.

backAria.description: Accessible label for the back button in settings.

captureModesAria.description: Accessible label for the capture mode buttons.

dismiss.description: Accessible label for the button that closes an error message.

resetDefaults.description: Settings link that restores every default value.

resetConfirm.description: Second-click confirmation label for the reset link.

delayLabel.description: Label for the capture delay row in the popup.

repeatLastRegion.description: Footer link and context menu item that re-captures the previous region selection.

popupSectionScreenshot.description: Popup: section heading above the three capture mode cards.

popupSectionRecord.description: Popup: section heading above the record card.

popupSectionOptions.description: Popup: section heading above the delay, after-capture, and icon-click rows.

recSourceLabel.description: Popup: label above the mic / tab audio / webcam toggle chips.

popupDigitHint.description: Popup: tooltip on a capture mode card naming its number-key shortcut.

reopenLastDisabledTitle.description: Popup: tooltip on the disabled reopen-last footer action.

repeatRegionDisabledTitle.description: Popup: tooltip on the disabled repeat-region footer action.

afterCaptureLabel.description: Label for the row that picks what a finished capture does.

actionEditor.description: Post-capture action that opens the annotation editor.

actionClipboard.description: Post-capture action that copies the screenshot and skips the editor.

actionDownload.description: Post-capture action that saves the screenshot and skips the editor.

actionHintPng.description: Hint shown under the after-capture row when Download is selected.

expressLabel.description: Label for the capture-on-icon-click row in the popup, and the icon context-menu checkbox.

expressOn.description: Express mode option that makes the toolbar icon capture directly.

expressOff.description: Express mode option that keeps the popup on icon click.

expressHint.message: The icon now captures the full page. Right-click the icon to turn this off.
expressHint.description: Hint shown under the express row when express mode is on.

recOverlayPause.description: Recording control bar: button that pauses the active recording.

recOverlayResume.description: Recording control bar: button that resumes a paused recording.

recOverlayStop.description: Recording control bar: button that stops and finalizes the recording.

recOverlayCancel.description: Recording control bar: button that cancels the recording and discards it.

recOverlayReveal.description: Recording control bar: accessible name of the small always-present control that reveals the hidden bar, by pointer, touch or keyboard focus.

recOverlayMic.description: Recording control bar: chip shown when the microphone track is enabled.

recOverlayTabAudio.description: Recording control bar: chip shown when tab audio is enabled.

recOverlayWebcam.description: Recording control bar: chip shown when the webcam track is enabled.

recTitle.description: Popup: title of the record row when no session is pending.

recSub.message: Record this tab with auto zoom
recSub.description: Popup: subtitle of the record row.

recStop.description: Popup: label for the button that stops the active recording.

recCancel.description: Popup: label for the button that cancels the active recording.

recRecording.description: Popup: status label shown while a recording is in progress.

recPaused.description: Popup: status label shown while a recording is paused.

recStarting.description: Popup: shown in place of the elapsed time while the recording is still opening its streams, before the clock has a zero.

recMic.description: Popup: toggle chip for the microphone track.

recTabAudio.description: Popup: toggle chip for the tab audio track.

recWebcam.description: Popup: toggle chip for the webcam track.

recWebcamDenied.description: Webcam preview bubble: shown in place of the video when the camera prompt is declined or the camera is unavailable.

recProtected.description: Popup: error toast shown when the active tab can't be recorded.

popupRecordRefused.message: Tab recording was not allowed — open setup
popupRecordRefused.description: Popup button shown after the user refuses the inline tabCapture prompt.

recFailStartUnreachable.message: Recording didn’t start — the extension didn’t answer. Try again.
recFailStartUnreachable.description: Popup: error toast when REC_START never reached the service worker.

recFailStartBlocked.message: Recording didn’t start — this page can’t be recorded. Switch to a normal tab and try again.
recFailStartBlocked.description: Popup: error toast when the start found no recordable tab (gone, or a protected URL).

recFailStartBusy.message: A recording is already running — stop it before starting another.
recFailStartBusy.description: Popup: error toast when a start arrives while a recording is live.

recFailStartFailed.message: Recording didn’t start — the tab couldn’t be prepared. Reload the tab and try again.
recFailStartFailed.description: Popup: error toast when the worker's start threw before the engine was asked to capture.

recFailCleanup.message: A failed recording is still stored — delete it on the Recorder page.
recFailCleanup.description: Popup: error toast when a failed session could not be tidied up.

recFailEngine.message: Recording stopped before it began — the tab couldn’t be captured. Try again.
recFailEngine.description: Popup: error toast when the offscreen engine failed to open its streams.

recFailEngineUnreachable.message: Nothing is being recorded — the recorder never started. Stop and try again.
recFailEngineUnreachable.description: Popup: error toast when OFFSCREEN_START never reached the offscreen engine, so the badge and control bar claim a recording that is not happening.

recFailEngineStalled.message: Recording didn’t start, and stopping it got no answer. Nothing was saved — try again.
recFailEngineStalled.description: Popup: the user pressed Stop on a recording that had not begun, and the offscreen recorder never answered. The run was torn down.

popupOpenFailed.message: That page couldn’t be opened. Try again.
popupOpenFailed.description: Popup: error toast when chrome.tabs.create fails for the setup page, the editor or the recorder.

recFailChunkWrite.message: Part of this recording isn’t being saved. Stop it and check what you have on the Recorder page.
recFailChunkWrite.description: Popup: error toast when a chunk write to IndexedDB failed mid-recording, so the file is shorter than the clock says.

recFailEventsWrite.message: The cursor track isn’t being saved. The video is fine; zoom and click effects will be missing.
recFailEventsWrite.description: Popup: error toast when cursor-event writes to IndexedDB failed mid-recording, leaving the video intact.

recOverlayStarting.description: Recording control bar: shown in place of the timer while the recording is still opening its streams. Keep it short; it replaces a 0:00 clock.

recOverlayNotSaving.description: Recording control bar: warning chip shown when chunks are failing to reach storage. Keep it short; it sits in a row of three-letter track chips.

recFailRecorderOpen.message: Your recording is saved — the Recorder page didn’t open. Use Recover last recording below.
recFailRecorderOpen.description: Popup: error toast when chrome.tabs.create for the recorder page failed after a recording finished.

recFailQuery.message: Recording status is unavailable — open the Recorder page to check.
recFailQuery.description: Popup: error toast when REC_QUERY threw, so "not recording" cannot be trusted.

recFailOverlayBlocked.message: The recording controls couldn’t open on this page — stop the recording from here.
recFailOverlayBlocked.description: Popup: error toast when the in-page control bar could not be injected.

recFailOverlayLost.message: The recording controls were lost on this page — stop the recording from here.
recFailOverlayLost.description: Popup: error toast when the in-page control bar stopped reporting mid-recording.

recFailControlUnreachable.message: That didn’t reach the recorder — the extension didn’t answer. Try again.
recFailControlUnreachable.description: Popup: error toast when stop/cancel never reached the service worker.

recFailSessionLoad.message: That recording couldn’t be opened — it may be incomplete.
recFailSessionLoad.description: Recorder page: error toast when a session could not be read out of IndexedDB.

recFailSegmentSkipped.message: Part of this recording wouldn’t play and was left out of the export.
recFailSegmentSkipped.description: Recorder page: error toast when one or more segments were skipped during an export.

recFailExport.message: Export failed — no file was saved. Try again.
recFailExport.description: Recorder page: error toast when the export threw.

recFailSaveInterrupted.message: Save failed: $ERROR$. The recording was kept.
recFailSaveInterrupted.description: Recorder page: error toast when the Save dialog's download was interrupted for a reason other than the user cancelling it.

recFailSaveUnverified.message: Could not confirm the save finished. The recording was kept.
recFailSaveUnverified.description: Recorder page: error toast when the download never reported a terminal state within the bounded wait.

recorderSaveCancelled.description: Recorder page: toast shown when the user dismisses the export's Save dialog.

recorderFailed.description: Recorder page: pill on a session whose recording never started.

recRecover.description: Popup: link that reopens the editor for a crashed/unfinished recording session.

recContinue.description: Popup: record row title when a continue-session is pending from the editor. Also the recorder page header button that starts a continue-session.

recAcrossSites.description: Settings: label for the row that grants recording access to all sites.

recAcrossSitesHint.message: Keeps the cursor overlay alive when the tab changes site. Grants access to all sites.
recAcrossSitesHint.description: Settings: hint shown under the record-across-sites row.

recOn.description: Segmented control option that turns a setting on.

recOff.description: Segmented control option that turns a setting off.

recorderOpen.description: Recorder page: button that opens a session for playback.

recorderDelete.description: Recorder page: button that deletes a session.

recorderDeleteConfirm.description: Recorder page: armed state of the delete button, click again to confirm.

recorderEmpty.message: No recordings yet. Record a tab from the popup.
recorderEmpty.description: Recorder page: shown when the session list is empty.

recorderLoadingList.description: Recorder page: shown in place of the session list while it loads.

recorderSessionLoading.description: Recorder page: label on the progress bar shown while a session's chunks load.

recorderSourceTab.description: Recorder page: session list row — capture source. Every recording is a tab capture; there is no window/screen source to distinguish yet.

recorderTrackRequested.description: Recorder page: session list row — a mic/webcam track that was asked for and has some evidence (the combined recorder-#2 stream exists) but cannot be confirmed individually, since a mic-only and a webcam-only stream are indistinguishable from chunk presence alone.

recorderRecovered.description: Recorder page: pill on a session that was left mid-recording by a crash.

recorderRecordingNow.description: Recorder page: pill on the session that is being recorded right now; its Open and Delete buttons are disabled.

recContinueHint.message: Open the popup on the tab you want to keep recording.
recContinueHint.description: Recorder page: info toast shown after Continue recording is clicked.

recorderAddZoom.description: Recorder page: button that adds a zoom block at the playhead.

recorderUndo.description: Recorder page: transport button that takes back the last timeline edit.

recorderRedo.description: Recorder page: transport button that puts back an edit undo took away.

recorderUndoAnnounce.description: Recorder page: live-region announcement after an undo, naming what the timeline holds afterwards.

recorderRedoAnnounce.description: Recorder page: live-region announcement after a redo, naming what the timeline holds afterwards.

recorderZoomBlockOne.description: Recorder page: the zoom-block count an undo/redo announcement carries, when there is exactly one.

recorderZoomBlockMany.description: Recorder page: the zoom-block count an undo/redo announcement carries, for none or several.

recorderDeleteZoom.description: Recorder page: button that removes the selected zoom block.

recorderZoomBlock.description: Recorder page: aria-label prefix of a zoom block on the timeline, followed by its scale (e.g. "Zoom block, 2×").

recorderZoomScale.description: Recorder page: label of the zoom scale segmented control.

recorderZoomTarget.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the draggable target reticle on the preview.

recorderTrimStart.description: Recorder page: aria-label of a segment's leading trim handle.

recorderTrimEnd.description: Recorder page: aria-label of a segment's trailing trim handle.

recorderTimelineAria.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the timeline region.

recorderRipple.description: Recorder page: label of the toggle that draws a ripple at every recorded click.

recorderPointer.description: Recorder page: label of the toggle that draws the recorded cursor path as a pointer in the video.

recorderVolTab.description: Recorder page: label of the tab-audio volume slider.

recorderVolMic.description: Recorder page: label of the microphone volume slider.

recorderBubble.description: Recorder page: label of the webcam bubble settings section.

recorderBubbleTL.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the webcam bubble's top-left corner preset button.

recorderBubbleTR.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the webcam bubble's top-right corner preset button.

recorderBubbleBL.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the webcam bubble's bottom-left corner preset button.

recorderBubbleBR.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the webcam bubble's bottom-right corner preset button.

recorderBubbleSize.description: Recorder page: label of the webcam bubble size slider.

recorderBubbleHide.description: Recorder page: label of the toggle that hides the webcam bubble.

recorderBeautify.description: Recorder page: label of the toggle that frames the export in padding, corners, shadow, and a background.

recorderBeautifyPadding.description: Recorder page: label of the beautify frame's padding slider.

recorderBeautifyCorners.description: Recorder page: label of the beautify frame's corner-radius slider.

recorderBeautifyShadow.description: Recorder page: label of the beautify frame's drop-shadow slider.

recorderBeautifyBackground.description: Recorder page: label of the beautify frame's background swatches.

recorderBeautifyTransparent.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the beautify frame's transparent-background swatch.

recorderBeautifyCustom.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the beautify frame's custom solid-colour swatch.

recorderExport.description: Recorder page: button that renders the edited recording to a WebM file.

recorderExporting.description: Recorder page: status shown while the export renders.

recorderCancel.description: Recorder page: button that stops an export in progress and discards it.

recorderCancelConfirm.description: Recorder page: armed state of the export Cancel button, click again to confirm.

recorderExportRemaining.description: Recorder page: wall-clock time left in an export in progress, formatted m:ss (or h:mm:ss for a long recording).

recorderExportStayVisible.message: Keep this tab visible. The render pauses while it's hidden.
recorderExportStayVisible.description: Recorder page: warning shown for the whole export — a background tab throttles requestAnimationFrame and stalls the render.

recorderExported.description: Recorder page: toast shown after an export is downloaded.

recorderDeleteAfter.description: Recorder page: checkbox that deletes the session once its export is saved.

setupIntro.description: Setup page: intro line under the heading.

setupFinish.description: Setup page: button on the ready banner that closes the tab.

setupTrustOpenSource.description: Setup page: trust pill linking to the GitHub repo.

setupTrustLocal.description: Setup page: trust pill — everything is processed on-device.

setupTrustNoTracking.description: Setup page: trust pill — no analytics, no accounts.

setupTrustHint.message: Your recordings never leave your device.
setupTrustHint.description: Setup page: one-line assurance under the trust pills.

setupPinTitle.description: Popup: nudge to pin the extension, shown while it is not on the toolbar.

setupPinSub.message: Click the 🧩 up there, then the 📌 next to OpenScreenShot.
setupPinSub.description: Popup: how to pin — the puzzle menu sits directly above the popup.

setupFromRecord.message: One step left: enable tab recording below.
setupFromRecord.description: Setup page: banner shown when the Record button routed here.

setupReady.description: Setup page: banner headline once tab recording is granted.

setupReadyHint.message: Click the toolbar icon and hit Record.
setupReadyHint.description: Setup page: what to do after setup is complete.

setupTabCapture.description: Setup page: row title for the tabCapture permission.

setupTabCaptureDesc.description: Setup page: row description for the tabCapture permission.

setupCamera.description: Setup page: row title for the camera permission.

setupCameraDesc.description: Setup page: row description for the camera permission.

setupMic.description: Setup page: row title for the microphone permission.

setupMicDesc.description: Setup page: row description for the microphone permission.

setupAcrossSites.description: Setup page: row title for the all-urls host permission.

setupAcrossSitesDesc.message: Keeps recording when you switch sites.
setupAcrossSitesDesc.description: Setup page: row description for the all-urls host permission.

setupAcrossSitesToggle.description: Setup page: label next to the all-urls toggle.

setupEnable.description: Setup page: button that requests the tabCapture permission.

setupAllow.description: Setup page: button that triggers a camera or mic prompt.

setupGranted.description: Setup page: status tag for a granted permission.

setupRequired.description: Setup page: status tag for the one required permission.

setupOptional.description: Setup page: status tag for a skippable permission.

setupDeniedTag.description: Setup page: status tag for a denied permission.

setupDismissed.message: Prompt closed — click again when ready.
setupDismissed.description: Setup page: hint after a permission prompt was closed without an answer.

setupBlockedSite.message: Blocked in Chrome. Allow it in site settings — this page updates itself.
setupBlockedSite.description: Setup page: recovery hint for a site-level denial.

setupBlockedSystem.message: Blocked by your OS. macOS: System Settings → Privacy & Security → allow Chrome.
setupBlockedSystem.description: Setup page: recovery hint for an OS-level denial.

setupNoDevice.message: No device found. Plug one in, then try again.
setupNoDevice.description: Setup page: hint when no camera or microphone exists.

setupOpenSiteSettings.description: Setup page: button that opens Chrome's per-site permission settings.

popupPermissionChip.description: Popup: warning chip when a toggled-on device permission is denied.

popupSetupLink.description: Popup settings: row that opens the recording setup page.
